writers.persona: a recruiter checking on the workload of an engineering team before an interview loop, asking in chat

wordings.wording: Quick one before I book interviews: PR #{n} is tied to a ticket. Who's that ticket assigned to?
The ticket linked to PR #{n}, when is that due? Trying to schedule the interview loop around deadlines.
What's the current status on the ticket that PR #{n} is attached to?
There's a PR that references ticket {k}. Who opened that PR?
Ticket {k} is linked to another ticket. What status is that other one in right now?
Ticket {k} links out to a second ticket. Who's that second one assigned to?
How many tickets are assigned to {p}? Just need the number so I can gauge their load before interviews.
Of all the tickets assigned to {p}, which one is due soonest? Can you give me the ticket key?
Between tickets {a} and {b}, which one has the earlier deadline?
Whoever picked up the action item "{t}" in the "{m}" meeting, which tickets are assigned to them? Ticket keys please.

writers.persona: a customer success manager preparing for a renewal call, writing a quick message to a colleague

wordings.wording: Hey, who's on the hook for the ticket tied to PR #{n}? Customer's going to ask on the renewal call.
Quick one: when is the ticket behind PR #{n} due? I need a date to give the customer.
Where does the ticket linked to pull request #{n} stand right now? What status is it showing?
Who put up the PR that references {k}? Want to give them a shout-out on the renewal call.
{k} is linked to another ticket. What status is that other one sitting in?
Who owns the ticket that's linked to {k}? I mean the other one, not the one I just mentioned.
How many tickets does {p} have on their plate right now?
Of everything assigned to {p}, which ticket is due soonest? Just send me the key.
Between {a} and {b}, which one is due first?
Whoever picked up the "{t}" action item in "{m}", which tickets are assigned to them? Can you send me the keys?

writers.persona: an operations intern on their second day, asking carefully and politely

wordings.wording: Sorry if this is a basic one, but could you tell me who the ticket linked to PR #{n} is assigned to?
Hi, could you please let me know when the ticket tied to pull request #{n} is due?
Could you help me check what status the ticket connected to PR #{n} is currently in, please?
There's a pull request that references ticket {k}. Would you mind telling me who opened that PR?
I see ticket {k} has another ticket linked to it. Could you please tell me what status that linked one is in right now?
Ticket {k} seems to be linked to a different ticket. Could you let me know who that other ticket is assigned to, please?
Sorry to bother you, but how many tickets does {p} currently have assigned to them?
Out of the tickets assigned to {p}, which one is due soonest? Could you give me its ticket key, please?
Could you please tell me which ticket has the earlier due date, {a} or {b}?
In the "{m}" meeting, someone took on the action item "{t}". Could you please list the keys of the tickets assigned to that person?
